text: F13.4c: K1-K2's system with the alphabet unknown, solved from the carved letters alone: alphabet and key guessed together.
Power first: planted messages at lengths 2-19, each against its own shuffles; then K4 against 50 shuffles where the plants are found.
Plants are found to length 5; there K4 sits inside its shuffles (p 0.37). Lengths 6-19 cannot be decided this way.
